footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Mar 28, 2026 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 1.1% to $3.7B in fiscal 2026 (ended Mar 28, 2026). Gross margin was 45.9%, versus 41.3% a year earlier, and operating income rose 4.3× to $411M, a 11.2% margin.
Net income rose 6.1× to $339M, or $3.62 per share. Operating cash flow was $809M and free cash flow $680M, versus $485M; Qorvo returned $533M through buybacks.
sources: Qorvo, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2026 (SEC EDGAR)
